**Nanomaterial:** Materials having structural components with at least one dimension in the nanoscale range ($1$ to $100\text{ nm}$).

**Difference from Bulk Materials:**
* **Surface Area-to-Volume Ratio:** Nanomaterials possess a drastically higher surface area-to-volume ratio compared to bulk materials, leading to enhanced reactivity.
* **Quantum Effects:** At the nanoscale, quantum confinement effects become prominent, altering electronic, optical, magnetic, and mechanical properties significantly relative to bulk counterparts.
proTip: Highlight the ultra-high surface-to-volume ratio and quantum confinement as the primary reasons for unique nanoscale properties.
